title: Yub-Nub 1978: Moonwood Space Village
description: Ewok Classic Space engineers launch Acorn One beneath yellow-glazed treetop mission huts. Their timber Galaxy Explorer rests on a living-tree flight deck, connected by a hanging bridge and open timber stairs. Real wedge wings and curved engine nacelles finish the spacecraft; broad roots support the village without a rectangular scenery base.

sections.name: Timber Galaxy Explorer and flight deck
